card.name: Words just before reported amounts or findings
card.fires_on: Small words and spaces right before a reported finding or figure, such as 'have been reported in human milk' or 'more than [space] 90%'. Mostly in drug-label text on milk excretion and absorption.

modes.label: Milk reports
modes.description: Linking word in a sentence saying a drug was found or reported in breast milk.
modes.example: Trace amounts of some NSAIDs have<< been>> reported in human milk.
